summary: @ornikar/webpack-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled identifiers and string-array indirection to hide its logic; it detects the installer's platform/arch (including musl/Alpine via /etc/os-release), downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmod +x's the binary, and execFileSyncs it against the sibling file math_init.js. If a local `bun` binary is already present it is used directly. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled blob (// @bun @bun-cjs) with a shuffled string-array decoder and hex-mangled identifiers; its contents are not human-readable. The declared main entry `index.js` is not shipped, so the package has no functional webpack-configuration code — its only install-time effect is fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated payload, bypassing Node-based scanners. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook and mismatches the package's stated purpose (webpack configuration).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
